<b>Wisps</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are short-lived sprites that explode into flames on impact summoned from lanterns. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
After a Wisp spawns, it flies away from Hornet. 2 seconds after spawning, if within range and line of sight, it flies towards Hornet and rapidly builds up speed, exploding into flame on impact with Hornet or a surface. If they touch water, they simply fizzle out. <br>
If a Wisp doesn't attack for around 8 seconds, the Wisp dissipates.<br>
If multiple Wisps are present, there is a delay between each Wisp's attacks, as opposed to all of them attacking at once.

Wisps deal {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} on contact. Equipping the [[Magma Bell]] reduces it to {{Damage|1|type=Fire}}.

The lanterns that spawn Wisps can be destroyed, preventing any more Wisps from spawning. Lanterns always take 4 hits to destroy, regardless of Needle or Tool upgrades, or are destroyed instantly with [[Heavy Damage]]. The lanterns ignore damage-over-time effects like [[Pollip Pouch]] and [[Flintslate]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Burning shape, all together...
* Call us, call us...
* Burn it! Burn it!
* Swoop... Burn... Seek!
}}

== Location ==
Wisps can be exclusively found in the [[Wisp Thicket]]. They only spawn from a Wisp Lantern, a [[Burning Bug]], or the [[Father of the Flame]], with Burning Bugs always being accompanied by two Wisps before being initiated. Their journal entry counter increases when a Wisp Lantern is destroyed.

==Trivia==
* Their Needolin dialogue only appears when playing the Needolin close to a Lantern, presumably to not conflict with the other enemies' Needolin dialogue. Additionally, their Needolin dialogue appears without them stopping to sing.
